chemistry-killer-05.topic: Isku-xirka ionic, isku-xirka covalent iyo oksidhaysho-yaraynta
chemistry-killer-05.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-05.material:
$\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ 0.2 M 50 mL waxaa lagu daray $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 0.1 M, waxaana la baaray wadarta ions-ka (mmol) ee xalka biyaha ku jira. Biyuhu ma tirinayo sida ion, falgalka $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ kaliya ayaa dhacaya.
Mugga NaOH(aq) lagu daray (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Wadarta ions (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Marka NaOH(aq) 150 mL la daro, waa kuwee, si isku xigta, saamiga tirada $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ ee xalka isku-darka ku jira, iyo (wadarta ions kadib isku-darka) ÷ (wadarta ions ee ku jirtay HCl(aq) 50 mL iyo NaOH(aq) 150 mL kahor isku-darka)? (Iska indho tir is-ionization-ka biyaha)
chemistry-killer-05.thinking.0: Isku-xirka ionic, isku-xirka covalent iyo oksidhaysho-yaraynta
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.prompt:
$\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ 0.2 M 50 mL waxaa lagu daray $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 0.1 M, waxaana la baaray wadarta ions-ka (mmol) ee xalka biyaha ku jira. Biyuhu ma tirinayo sida ion, falgalka $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ kaliya ayaa dhacaya.
Mugga NaOH(aq) lagu daray (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Wadarta ions (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Marka NaOH(aq) 150 mL la daro, waa kuwee, si isku xigta, saamiga tirada $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ ee xalka isku-darka ku jira, iyo (wadarta ions kadib isku-darka) ÷ (wadarta ions ee ku jirtay HCl(aq) 50 mL iyo NaOH(aq) 150 mL kahor isku-darka)? (Iska indho tir is-ionization-ka biyaha)
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Fasiraadda shaxda. 0 mL: H+ 10 + Cl- 10 = 20. 50 mL: H+ 5, Cl- 10, Na+ 5 = 20. 100 mL: Cl- 10, Na+ 10 = 20 (neutralization point). Ilaa neutralization point, H+ waxaa lagu beddelaa Na+ 1:1, sidaa darteed wadarta ions way joogtaa.
Tallaabo 2: 150 mL: NaOH wuxuu bixiyaa Na+ 15 mmol, OH- 15 mmol. H+ 10 mmol iyo OH- 10 mmol way falgalaan oo la isticmaalaa, sidaa darteed OH- 5 mmol ayaa hadhay. Ions = Na+ 15, Cl- 10, OH- 5 → saamiga tirada 3 : 2 : 1, wadar 30 mmol.
Tallaabo 3: Wadarta ions kahor isku-darka = (10 + 10) + (15 + 15) = 50 mmol. Saamiga = 30/50 = 3/5.
Jawaab: 3 : 2 : 1, 3/5 (a). (Jawaabaha khaldan: OH- oo la dhigay 15 halkii 5 waxay iska indho tirtay neutralization, 5/3 waa saamiga oo rogan, 3/4 waxay si qalad ah u tirisay wadarta ions kahor isku-darka 40.)
